execution: async; same shared adapter as REM-16, exclusive disposable DB per active pack
proofs: Exact checks use ARC-XX:sous-probe. Native X files are in supervisor evidence_root/<snapshot SHA>/architecture. Type/file SHA/snapshot/contract all checked; missing source/frontend proof is NOT_VERIFIED.
sqlite: connect_db must create a real distinct sqlite3.Connection to isolated fixture DB using product's connection configuration. Canonical columns are documented below. Alternate physical table names require trusted metadata.sqlite_tables; missing columns are NOT_VERIFIED, never guessed success.

canonical_columns.idempotency_keys: A seeded dedicated relational row; cloning unchanged must fail UNIQUE. Independent source review required for durable key definition.

ports.connect_db: actual SQLite connections, no fake ORM/canned result
ports.app_connection_pragmas: actual HTTP handler connection instrumentation: list[{connection_id,foreign_keys,busy_timeout_ms}], at least two connections. Direct harness connections enabling FK do not prove product connection FK. Missing instrumentation -> NOT_VERIFIED.
ports.full_database_state: all tables and rows including sessions/keys; before/after equality and SHA, not counters alone
ports.migrate_fresh: trusted reviewed command targeting genuinely empty disposable DB, returns exit_code/command/output without credentials
ports.populate_migration_fixture: populate disposable migration DB through independent fixture; do not touch user DB
ports.migrate_replay: replay same reviewed migration command over populated DB, retaining all row data and keys
ports.sql_trace_start: start product connection SQL tracing after login
ports.sql_trace: actual SELECT statements for 1 and 50 tickets; bound SQL literals redacted before evidence retention
ports.query_plan: actual EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN rows for list/message statements, reviewed with source index rationale
ports.timestamp_ties: fixed fixture equal timestamps, metadata.tie_expected independent exact UUID descending order
ports.advance_clock: real injectable clock used by product session service; absolute 8h expiry tested via actual HTTP/cookie

client_execution_X: ARC-06:error_client must observe actual frontend consuming an actual API error and display_name DTO binding, not a mocked client fixture or source-only inference. Supervisor/REM-18/19 supplies artifact; absence -> NOT_VERIFIED.
counterexamples: NULL TEXT PRIMARY KEY accepted without explicit NOT NULL
version=1.5 accepted without integer type CHECK
migration replay changes a full row
same related-ticket query executed once for one row and fifty times for fifty rows
limits: Direct SQLite probes clone unrelated seed fields but mutate fixed contract invariants; every attempted insert is rolled back inside savepoint.
API fixture is intentionally minimal/catch-all and fails ARC-06 incomplete OpenAPI. It is not presented as full product compliance.
Native OpenAPI checks verify real route/method/schema inventory and real strict/error responses; public DTO/service boundaries and real frontend execution remain separately evidenced.
No arbitrary layer/index/file-size or absolute throughput threshold. Busy configured wait <=5s and HTTP measurement <=5.5s are distinguished.
Embedded small collections require bound proof and remain NOT_VERIFIED; unrelated harmless lists are not automatically architecture failures.
All source-only architecture criteria preserve historical results without assuming they remain valid on current snapshot.
